sv.title: Olive Martin dödförklarades – vaknade på bårhuset
sv.summary: Olive Martin dödförklarades i ambulansen. Senare vaknade 54-åringen upp på bårhuset. Nu kräver hennes familj svar, skriver Chronicle Live.

en.title: Olive Martin declared dead – woke up in the morgue
en.summary: Olive Martin was declared dead in the ambulance. Later the 54-year-old woke up in the morgue. Now her family demands answers, writes Chronicle Live.
